verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Rippling has general developer APIs, a sandbox, a CLI for building integrations, and UI-based onboarding. None of it documents API endpoints an agent could call to create an employee, set compensation, or configure tax setup. Generic 'build custom apps' API claims and in-app onboarding are adjacent building blocks and features, not the end-to-end API onboarding this story asks for.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent onboard a new hire end-to-end via the API — creating the employee, compensation, and tax setup
